description: The plot illustrates the training loss of various models over a range of steps, with the x-axis labeled "Step" and spanning from 0 to 440K in a linear scale, with tick labels at intervals of 20K from 0 to 80K and a separate interval from 420K to 440K. The y-axis is labeled "Train Loss" and ranges from 0.0 to 0.85 in a linear scale, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2 from 0.0 to 0.8, and an additional label at 0.85. The plot displays six lines representing different models: ChemBART Small 20M (red, solid), ChemBART Medium 20M (blue, solid), ChemBERTa Small 20M (green, solid), ChemBERTa Medium 20M (orange, solid), ChemLLaMA Small 20M (purple, solid), and ChemLLaMA Medium 20M (brown, solid). All lines exhibit a similar trend, starting at a high training loss around 0.75-0.8 at 0 steps and decreasing rapidly to around 0.1-0.2 at 40K steps, followed by a gradual decline to approximately 0.05 at 80K steps, and continuing to decrease at a slower rate until 440K steps, with values ranging from around 0.02 to 0.05. The lines remain relatively smooth throughout, with some minor fluctuations.
